descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Industria ospitalității
We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator with a focus on Compliance to join our Corporate IT team. You’ll share responsibility for global IT support and be the person who makes our IT governance, identity management and security compliance work in practice. Reporting to the Head of IT & Compliance, you’ll work closely with our Infrastructure and People & Culture teams. You’ll do well here if you are precise, work by the process, and care about getting security and data privacy right.
 Your time is split roughly 50/50: half in our global IT support (shared rotation with a second System Administrator), half on IT compliance and security topics.
 Tasks 
 Act as first responder for global IT support tickets (Jira/Slack) during your weekly rotation, resolving Tier 1–3 issues and keeping SLAs high
 Run employee onboarding and offboarding, including manual steps where automation isn't in place yet
 Lead the technical side of our SOC 2 / ISO 27001 readiness: manage the Vanta integration, gather technical evidence and close gaps in technical controls
 Enforce endpoint security policies (ESET, VPN usage) across the company
 Follow documented remote-wipe procedures for all offboarded hardware before it is shipped
 Audit active users, privileged access, shadow IT and admin changes in our core business systems on a regular basis
 Enforce SaaS governance rules and make sure all tools comply with our password and lifecycle policies
 Requirements 
 3+ years of experience in systems administration, corporate IT or IT security
 Solid hands-on experience with access management (SSO/MFA), endpoint security and user lifecycle processes
 Strong skills in administering Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence)
 Close attention to detail and to processes for data privacy (GDPR) and security protocols
 A service mindset, clear communication and enjoyment of working closely with colleagues across countries
 Fluent English and Romanian
 Based in Romania, with regular presence at our Cluj-Napoca office
 Nice to have 
 Experience with IT compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) or compliance tools such as Vanta, or a strong interest in growing into this area
 Scripting/automation skills (e.g. Python, Google Apps Script)
 Fluent in German 
 Benefits 
 Global & Diverse Team: Work in a collaborative, multicultural environment.
 Flexibility: Flexible working hours to help you shape your own work-life balance.
 Growth: Ongoing career development, training, and coaching.
 Learning Time: Six dedicated days per year for learning and development.
 Culture: Regular team events (in-person and virtual) and location-based social benefits.
 AI Transparency & Human Oversight Notice 
 To help us manage high application volumes, we may use AI tools to assist with administrative tasks, such as parsing CV formats and matching skills to job profiles.
 In strict compliance with the EU AI Act and GDPR, we guarantee that:
 Human-in-the-Loop: No hiring or rejection decisions are made by algorithms alone. A human recruiter reviews every recommendation and retains final decision-making power.
 Fairness & Privacy: Our tools are strictly vetted for data security and to prevent algorithmic bias.
 TrustYou is an equal-opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of gender, background, religion, orientation, age, or ability.
